name: Winds of Laughter
description: Denton mahjong social club with beginner classes and open play; its open play page says players must bring a "National Mahjongg Card (2026)" (American/NMJL). Open play requires completing Introduction to Mahjong or an equivalent class. Events at the Miller Center, FUMC Denton.
schedule: Rookie Play Sundays 2:00-4:30 PM; Monday night open play every other Monday 5:45-8:30 PM; Introduction to Mahjong every other Monday 5:45-8:30 PM (open play free; class price not confirmed)

name: Open Play Mahjong with the Texan Trippers
description: Free open play for players who already know the game at First United Methodist Church of Denton (enter via Mulberry Street side). Event page says "Players should bring their NMJL card"; advance sign-up required via Google Form.
address: First United Methodist Church of Denton, 201 S Locust St, Denton, TX 76201
schedule: Every other Monday 6:00-8:30 PM (per Meetup event page)

name: FUMC Denton Open Play Mahjong
description: Free open play in the Miller Center at FUMC Denton; everyone welcome. Page mentions a "2025 card" but does not spell out American/NMJL, so needs review.
address: Miller Center, First United Methodist Church of Denton, 201 S Locust St, Denton, TX 76201
